name: Aqir
shortDescription: Resilient insectoid servants formed from the Old Gods' organic matter, first set to building the Black Empire and later drawn into a world-spanning war with the ancient troll powers.
body: The atlas treats the aqir as a changing ancient people rather than a single timeless empire. The northern and southern successor societies that emerged from their retreat belong to later map states and should not be collapsed into one precise border.
